item.title: RimWorld Defense Layout Guide — Kill Box, Walls & Turrets (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: A good RimWorld defense layout is the difference between losing a colony and losing nothing. Here's how to design defenses for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Core Defense Principles Funnel the enemy: walls force raiders through one choke point (kill box). Cover beats numbers: sandbags, embrasures and walls give your shooters a 50%+ edge. Turrets absorb: autocannons and mini-turrets tank fire while pawns shoot from cover. Multiple layers: a perimeter wall plus interior bunkers saves the colony when one line falls.
